description: This file defines a FastAPI application for a Notes REST API. It sets up endpoints for health checks, creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, using in-memory storage and Pydantic schemas for data validation.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Schema representing a note with id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new note, capturing title and content.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing note, with optional title and content.

methods.name: datetime _now_utc()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime with timezone awareness.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Endpoint to check service health; returns a simple 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID, timestamps, and stores it in-memory.

methods.name: list_notes()
methods.description: Returns all notes in insertion order.

methods.name: get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to retrieve"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to update"), )
methods.description: Updates an existing note, modifying title and/or content, and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to delete"), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, raises 404 if it doesn't exist.

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to delete"), )

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to retrieve"), )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to update"), )
